summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for $1.313M aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due June 30, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Russell 2000 Index and EURO STOXX 50 Index. The notes are senior unsecured obligations under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program, issued at $1,000 per note. This is a routine debt issuance with structured equity-linked features, not a special situation like a merger, tender, or activist campaign. The filing is an ordinary takedown from an existing shelf registration, with no transformative corporate event.
